X.most_important_defect: It commits somewhat prematurely to a specific navigation restructuring, including retiring Home and relocating KPI content, despite limited evidence for the exact nav-tree choice.

case_summary: All three outputs reach the authority-aligned decision: make cross-location Needs Attention the default returning experience, retain KPI reporting for periodic review, and remove location-first constraints from exception work.
